description: ONE measured trade setup for the owner's goal — the best row inside their risk tier from the ranked setups (vehicles, hedged pairs, their own multi-vehicle fund, theme baskets, fund tokens, event cards, arbitrage; only what a venue can fill right now) — plus a lower-risk and a faster alternative, each with risk tier, net probable return and lower bound, measured share of starts that reached the target and typical days, worst measured move, size, and `execution`: the exact calls in order. Negotiate by sending the owner's words as `reply` ('lower risk', 'faster', 'only crypto', 'swap NVDA', 'use BTC, ETH, SOL') with the same conversation_id — answered from the same measured rows in about a second. Nothing is placed here; the owner says yes first. Past measurement, never a promise. (no key needed)

asset_class.description: Stocks, crypto, or both (the user's choice; one class = one vehicle).

conversation_id.description: returned by the first call; send it on every turn

horizon_days.description: days the owner can give it (default 30)

risk_tier.description: 1 very low … 5 very high, or plain words ('conservative', 'aggressive'); default 3

symbols.description: the owner's own picks — builds their own fund from exactly these

usdc_amount.description: dollars of the owner's own money
